title: CHAPTER 7: SARKARI PATRA-LEKHANA :OFFICIAL CORRESPONDENCE IN HINDI

blocks.content: 7.1 Types of Official Letters in Hindi

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Official Correspondence in Hindi is categorized under Sarkari Patra-Lekhana.
Administrative communications follow distinct categories and types of official letters in Hindi.
Formal Hindi letter writing adheres to standardized structural formats for government correspondence.
Noting and Drafting (नोटिंग एवं ड्राफ्टिंग) form the foundational process of preparing official files and responses.

blocks.content: CHAPTER 7: SARKARI PATRA-LEKHANA :OFFICIAL CORRESPONDENCE IN HINDI

cells: Internal order within an organisation; addressed to subordinate; numbered; no salutation
Transfer orders, posting orders, disciplinary orders, duty assignments
Communication between two Government offices at same level; no salutation; no complimentary close; impersonal
Instructions/information sent to many offices simultaneously; number assigned; reference to relevant rules
Published in Gazette; formal legal notice; for information of all concerned; standard format
Between organisations of different status; has salutation (महोदय) and complimentary close (भवदीय)
State Govt to Central Govt; bank to customer; bank to regulatory body
Personal touch but official purpose; officer to officer; 'My Dear' or 'महोदय' opening; first person
Senior officer to peer on official matter; softer tone than OM; seeks cooperation
Pass a letter to next authority; brief note; original letter attached
Forwarding a complaint or application to appropriate authority

blocks.content: 7.2 Format of a Formal Hindi Letter

cells: Top left: Office letter number and date in Hindi numerals (or both Hindi and English)
Name and designation of sender; office name and address
Name, designation, and address of recipient; 'सेवा में' above recipient's details
Brief one-line subject of letter; followed by colon; bold or underlined
Paragraph 1: reference/background; Paragraph 2: main matter; Paragraph 3: conclusion/request/expected action
भवदीय (yours faithfully :to superior or peer); आपका (more informal); ends with name and designation
Handwritten signature; name in brackets below; designation; office stamp if required
List of documents enclosed; if any; at bottom left
Names of others receiving copies; at bottom

items: Distinction between various types of official Hindi letters (Sarkari Patra) is a frequent exam question.
The exact layout and mandatory structural elements of formal Hindi official letters are heavily tested.
Terminology and procedural rules regarding Noting and Drafting (नोटिंग एवं ड्राफ्टिंग) are essential for competitive administrative tests.

blocks.content: Noting refers to the process of recording facts, analysis, and recommendations on a file that goes through the official hierarchy. Drafting means preparing the text of outgoing communication based on the decision reached through noting. For Rajbhasha Adhikari, doing noting and drafting directly in Hindi (as opposed to first writing in English and then translating) is the ideal.

cells: Written in first person or third person; should be factual; avoid long sentences; paragraph per point; should lead logically to a conclusion/recommendation
Should be in Hindi for Region A offices; in Hindi or English for Region B; in English for Region C; original Hindi noting preferred over translated noting
Draft should match tone of communication (formal/informal/urgent); follow prescribed format; clearly state action required
Some sensitive matters: noting may be done in both languages; Hindi version is primary where both present
Should use standard vocabulary; avoid anglicisms where Hindi word exists; use approved technical terms from CSTT glossaries
